deadline.value: The full application to UC Davis is due December 1. Selected applicants then submit an abbreviated application through Cal State Apply.
deadline.quote: First, a full application (including transcripts) is submitted to UC Davis for the Joint Doctoral Program in Ecology on or before December 1

gre_subject.value: Ecology has no GRE Subject test, and the pages do not mention one.

supervisor.value: Applicants need an SDSU faculty sponsor who agrees to take them into the lab before they can be admitted.
supervisor.quote: All students must have a faculty sponsor within the Ecology Program Area at SDSU who agrees to accept them into their laboratory as a requirement for acceptance into the Ph.D. program.

funding.value: Admitted students are offered assistantship support, typically for 5 years as long as they make satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the Joint Doctoral Program Ecology (JDPE) are offered support from Graduate Research Assistantships (GAs) or Teaching Assistantships (TAs)

also.quote: Students typically will receive support for 5 years, as long as they are making satisfactory progress

entry_route.value: The ecology pages do not say whether a bachelor's degree alone is enough.

notes: Joint PhD with UC Davis; applicants apply to both universities. The SDSU ecology pages say a GPA above 3.2 is needed for full consideration. No fetched SDSU ecology page mentions the GRE, so the university GRE rule applies. Ecology is mapped to environment.
name: Ecology, Ph.D. (joint with UC Davis)
